answer: Anchor gate nonce: each identity must sign a SHA-256 proof of a chain-derived random beacon rotating every 200 blocks. The gale of unpredictable challenges means an attacker cannot precompute N sybil responses and must run a live GPU per identity to meet the 300 ms deadline. A missed window strips that identity of 12 hours of routing rights in the meadow ledger, so sybil count scales GPU cost linearly.
